name: Wizard OS 0.3.47 — fresh-install linger fallback
about: Published 0.3.46 bundle, with WAM #226 fixing fresh installs that exhaust loginctl enable-linger retries after systemd package upgrades. Root-only fallback sets the linger flag and starts user@UID.service, restoring SELinux labels when available; ordinary non-root behavior is unchanged. All non-WAM pins, images and default apps remain exactly 0.3.46. Latest only; fresh/upgrade/backup release gates are still required. Published 0.3.45 bundle, with WAM #223 selecting noninteractive sudo for the same local Docker socket when the owner’s Docker-group membership is not yet active. Sanitized child environments, streamed helpers and bounded environment-scoped access caching are covered by regression tests and a daemon-free Thales subprocess probe. Fresh/upgrade/backup release gates are still required; this cut is latest only. Published 0.3.44 bundle (including Voice and Connection Router defaults), with WAM #221 fixing owner-user backup discovery, metadata reads and restore/Undo of root-only container-owned agent trees. 0.3.40 bundle with WAM main through #213: backup/restore #61 (verified encrypted export/import, paused cron/messaging/backups and Undo, Mac companion engine), report and strict contact #166, install retry #209; non-author review fixes kept-app credential loss, durable app/volume Undo archives, kept-tree interrupted-swap recovery and confirmed agent stops. All non-WAM pins remain 0.3.40; does not take the separately reserved 0.3.41 defaults/UI candidate. Small tester group only. Known limitations: Wizard scheduler is not paused/checkpointed/reconciled; stop source Service before export, inspect schedules with destination stopped/offline. AI login refresh is not fenced by activation: old box off before import or destination offline until exclusive handover. Tailscale and external alongside/linked grants re-enrol. Not an online clone. James explicitly waived the 72h latest soak on 25 Oct 2026; stable promotion still requires fresh install, upgrades from 0.3.39 and 0.3.40, and new-version backup/restore evidence.

modes.fresh: blank Ubuntu/Debian box: Runtipi + App Manager + the default app in every spot (including hermes-agent)
modes.alongside: box that already runs Hermes (run as its owner): App Manager + apps + the Wizard shell pointed at that Hermes; `wizard link` connects it, `wizard unlink` reverses it byte for byte

install.note: Fresh and alongside installs both take every default app at the source commit pinned below, and the Wizard UX and Agent Service images at the digests above; the installer reads back what runs (a default app on another source commit fails; index versions are informational and reported as drift). No catalog release is changed by this snapshot.

wizard-app-manager.note: Main through #226: preserve #223 backup Docker access and add a root-only direct linger flag/user manager fallback after all loginctl retries fail. Restore SELinux policy labels when available and retain non-root behavior and the bus-socket wait. Required exact-head gitleaks/test green. Image-input diff from attested 80c76cf remains empty; builder skill documentation also carried forward.

wizard-troubleshooter.note: Host tooling, no image: installed by `wam troubleshooter` as user systemd units (wizard-troubleshooter.service + wizard-guardian.timer, report-only) from exactly this commit; c434bbe plus #9 (connection app links follow apps.json; no dead Claude button when Claude Code is missing).

wizard-agent-service.note: Official main through #151; preserves final #149 guards after #150 supersession.

wizard-ux.note: Official main through #483; first-run orientation for alongside installs and the desktop shell.

wizard-app-manager.note: Official multi-arch main image from 80c76cf, workflow run 40171067383. Attestation reverified; full image-input diff to b0333e7b is empty. Python backup engine is host-installed WAM source, not an image build input; no hand-built image.

shell.note: Alongside installs use the immutable official image above; index drift is informational.

ai-connection.note: Host Hermes owns and renews its sign-in; the connection app reads sanitized usage through the wizard-os dashboard plugin. Claude is installed by default as its own `claude-subscription` row below.

claude-subscription.note: Installed on every box next to ChatGPT. Alongside with host Hermes on a claude-subscription provider: App Manager binds the agent's own Claude Code login folder at the engine's /claude, so Connect/Test and auto-renew act on the agent's sign-in; tokens are never copied.

secrets.note: secret-drop #1: the engine image is pinned by its multi-arch digest (secret-drop:0.1.1@sha256:29ebc6a7…c03302), the same bytes as the 0.1.1 tag in 0.3.19.

hermes.test_record: none: carried over from 0.3.21, pinned before Wizard stable existed

notes: 0.3.42 backup/restore bundle with WAM host registry permission fixes (#217). Root-only grants resolve through the App Manager API; the projection writer no longer eagerly reopens backend state. James explicitly waived the 72h latest soak on 25 Oct for the first small tester group by Tue 27 Oct; real fresh, 0.3.39/0.3.40 upgrade and backup/restore/Undo gates remain required before stable. Stable stays 0.3.39; this cut is not acceptance evidence. Other component and image pins are unchanged. 0.3.44 preserves the complete published 0.3.43 bundle and adds only Voice (0.2.2-rc1.app1) and Connection Router (0.1.4) default pins; Agent History is explicitly reserved null and Connected accounts remains on-demand. James approved publishing these two defaults with “Publish” on 24 Oct 2026 (PR #206). This does not include the separate PR #211 UX amendment: 0.3.43 UX source/image/shell remain exact. No channel promotion or acceptance is implied; current-stable upgrade, fresh install and inherited backup/restore/Undo gates remain required. Existing per-app compose files pin their engine digests; no additional top-level images are required. 0.3.45 changes only WAM source to #221; all other component/image/default-app pins remain exactly 0.3.44. Real disposable root0700 leaf and ancestor permission probes reproduce the old failure and pass fixed discovery, metadata and atomic set-aside/Undo with env owner/mode preserved. Linux CI also exercises the exact descriptor-anchored helper and a replaced-ancestor attack regression. These cheap checks are not the pending fresh/upgrade/backup acceptance gates. Stable stays 0.3.39; no soak/promotion or passed-upgrade evidence is manufactured. 0.3.47 changes only WAM source to #226, with all other pins and defaults exactly 0.3.46. Focused installer tests: 25 passed; regression cases fail before the review hardening. Official WAM image attestation reverified; all declared image build inputs are byte-identical from source 80c76cf to d231656. The disposable acceptance fixture is repaired separately in wizard-os #225; no acceptance pass is claimed. Stable remains 0.3.39.
